title: The Kraken Was Under Our Boat
summary: A boy who never received a sea creature grabs his family’s mooring rope and discovers who has been holding their boat up all his life.
frame_0: Rockboy stands on the gray reef while two tentacles lift the Queen’s flagship behind him. The title sits against the sails.
package_differences: The harbor story uses the November 25 locked-camera direction and the original Reflection cast fitted before Cast v2.
The clean edition ends with the story at 132.3 seconds. The sponsor edition continues into the approved 9.30-second Flashloop phone sequence with the reef-eye reveal as its preview.
